summary: Describes the functionality to add multiple student records to the system efficiently using an Excel file. Users can download a sample Excel template, populate it with mandatory student details, and then upload the file for bulk data entry.
steps: Locate and click on the 'Excel Upload' option.
Click on 'Sample Excel' to download the template file.
Fill in all mandatory student data (e.g., Name, Father Name, Mother Name) in the downloaded Excel file.
Upload the completed Excel file to add students in bulk to the system.
business_rules: All mandatory data fields in the Excel template must be filled for successful bulk upload.
important_notes: This feature significantly streamlines the process of adding a large number of students.
A sample Excel template is provided to ensure users input data in the correct format and include all required fields.
questions: How can I add multiple students to the system simultaneously?
Where can I find the sample Excel template for bulk student upload?
What are the mandatory fields required when adding students via Excel upload?
